data.name: Myriam Design

reviews.text:
I have had the pleasure of working with Myriam on several projects (powder room, entrance and fireplace) with a kitchen project starting in April.

I completely trust Myriam’s opinion.  She has wonderful taste and always ensures what you choose works with the rest of the house. She is very honest and explains to you why something will not work. She will give you ideas you never thought of, often cheaper alternatives.

She is very personable and so easy to work with. I would not hesitate to recommend her.

Working with Myriam was our first major home renovation and she helped to make every step enjoyable. She truly has a great vision for design, colour and functionality and the end result was much better than we’d originally envisaged. Myriam deftly balanced our “wish list” with practical solutions, and helped us broaden our view to consider alternative approaches, while remaining true to our family’s lifestyle. The project execution was delayed due to the pandemic, but Myriam worked with us and our general contractor to adjust the schedule and keep a reasonable completion date.

It was a true pleasure working with Myriam and we won’t hesitate to contact her again for our next big project!

When I sold my house and downsized into a 4 1/2 apartment I contacted Myriam. At first I thought that perhaps my project would be too small for her, but she reassured me that she took on all sizes of projects. Myriam is a wonderful designer and a pleasant person to deal with. She has great ideas and works within the customer's budget. I love my new apartment.  and I would highly recommend Myriam.

Won over! We were won over and charmed from the first meeting! The master bathroom needed some love after 30 years of wear and tear. We told Myriam we wanted a turnkey style project, because we hate shopping and tackling this project alone scared us. She listened to our wishes and created a plan that blew us away! We wanted a Zen space that would stand the test of time. She delivered! We wanted quality Quebec products, as much as possible, and she found that for us. I keep recommending her to friends! We have other projects to come with Myriam! The whole house is 30 years old! Thank you again Myriam for understanding what we wanted and for making what we had in mind come true. Our bathroom is our haven of peace - Lynn and Michel

Having previously used Myriam's services for our bathroom renovation, we didn't hesitate for a moment before calling on her again when it came time to do the same for our kitchen. The original partition walls didn't give us enough flexibility to achieve our vision, so we asked Myriam to design an open-plan layout. We were thrilled with her proposal.
The project would inevitably involve removing the two main walls on the upper floor, including the main load-bearing wall, but we knew we could trust Myriam to assemble a team of highly skilled professionals to carry out this complex work.
The project was supported by an exceptional team: from the contractor to his workers, from the electrician and cabinetmakers to the painters, all completed on schedule and with continuous communication. She has impeccable taste, numerous creative ideas, and concrete recommendations backed by a network of competent and reliable suppliers. The result is beyond our expectations!

Isabelle & Sylvain
